authoring_instructions: {"spear-captain-main-v2": "Create a production 2D isometric RPG sprite atlas from the attached ORIGINAL portrait, preserving the exact character design, silhouette, palette, face and equipment. Each complete sprite INCLUDING weapon is at most 55% of cell width and height, large transparent gutters and outer border. No text, no grid, no scenery, no shadows crossing cells. The eight columns MUST face E, SE, S, SW, W, NW, N, NE, in this exact order. E is a STRICT RIGHT profile with face/nose pointing directly right. SE is front-right. S looks straight down toward viewer, centered face and both shoulders. SW is front-left, nose/weapon pointing lower LEFT. W is STRICT LEFT profile, face/nose directly left. NW back-left, N centered FULL BACK with NO FACE visible, NE back-right. Do not repeat the same three-quarter front view across directions. Every row must keep the same compass. Rows 1 neutral idle; 2 distinct breathing idle; 3 walking first step; 4 passing stance; 5 opposite step; 6 strong attack windup; 7 actual contact striking in its column facing direction; 8 recovery. Real articulated limbs, not displaced duplicates. Body scale constant and weapon fully connected in every cell. All frames separated by at least 25px transparent padding. This is the original silver/white armored spear captain. Preserve the fully closed pointed helmet, white/silver armor plates and black joints, deep dark purple cape and ONE long lavender-purple bladed polearm in his original hand. No shield, sword, axe, facial skin, wings or added horns. Attack is a thrust with that same long polearm: drawn back windup, forward thrust contact, retract recovery, aimed exactly in each column facing. The modest lavender weapon edge may glow tightly but no large circular aura, lightning cloud, particles or trails. Keep ALL spear tip and butt inside each cell.", "spear-captain-main-spaced": "Edit the layout of this transparent sprite sheet: MAKE EVERY SPEAR CAPTAIN SPRITE SIXTY PERCENT OF ITS CURRENT SIZE RELATIVE TO ITS CELL. Preserve the exact original character design, details and colors, face/helmet, single weapon, viewing directions and all eight different actions; ONLY relative sprite size and spacing should change. Each complete sprite including extended weapon occupies at most sixty percent of cell width and height, never touches neighboring sprites, with at least twenty-five empty transparent pixels between bodies and weapons in every row and column. Same elevated 2D isometric view. Columns left to right STRICT E screen-right profile, SE front-right, S directly front toward viewer, SW front-left, W screen-left profile, NW back-left, N full back with NO face visible, NE back-right. Retain the exact silver-white closed pointed helmet and armor, black joints, deep purple cape, and ONE lavender bladed polearm. No exposed face or skin, no shield/sword/new horns.
